senses.en: bad-tempered and easily annoyed
examples: I have not had enough sleep lately and I am feeling kind of [[grumpy]].

senses.en: (BrE visualise) form a picture of sb. / sth. in your mind
examples: An architect can look at a drawing and [[visualize]] a three-dimensional shape.

senses.en: a piece of work that a student is asked to do
examples: Students will need to complete three written [[assignments]] this semester.

senses.en: a piece of work that is given to sb. as part of their job
examples: She told me that she will be in Greece next week on [[assignment]] for one of the national newspapers.

senses.en: laugh at sb. or shout rude remarks at them to show that you do not respect them
examples: After the match, the disappointed fans were all [[jeering]] at the football team.

senses.en: (not in progressive) surprise or upset sb. so much that they do not react immediately
examples: Sasha was too [[stunned]] by what had happened in the office to say a word.

senses.en: (fml.) (~ with) continue doing sth. that has already been started; continue being done
examples: The discussions between the two firms are [[proceeding]] slowly but satisfactorily.

senses.en: form or make sth. form a curved shape
examples: His eyebrows [[arched]] as if he were angry.

senses.zh: 耸（肩）（以示怀疑、 与己无关、不知道等）
senses.en: raise one's shoulders slightly to express doubt, indifference, ignorance, etc.
examples: He [[shrugged]] his shoulders as if to say that there was nothing he could do about it.

senses.en: a house or an area of a city that is in very bad condition, where very poor people live
examples: My friend Bobby lives with his three sisters in a [[slum]] near the city center, but he doesn't lose faith in life.

senses.zh: （商品、技能等）有市场的，有销路的，畅销的
senses.en: marketable goods, skills, etc. can be sold easily because people want them
examples: The program is designed to provide students with real, [[marketable]] skills.

senses.zh: 自满的，自鸣得意的，沾沾自喜的（含贬义）
senses.en: showing too much satisfaction with your own cleverness or success — used to show disapproval
examples: Peter was wearing an unbearably [[smug]] expression and waving the tickets in front of me.

senses.zh: 挑逗性的或不怀好意的目光
senses.en: an unpleasant look suggesting lust or ill will
examples: He has a most unpleasant [[leer]].

senses.en: the length, height, width, depth or diameter of sth.
examples: It is important to measure the exact [[dimensions]] of the room before buying furniture.

senses.en: a part of a situation or a quality involved in it
examples: You can have a spiritual [[dimension]] to your life without being religious.

senses.en: think about sth. seriously for a period of time
examples: As he lay in his hospital bed that night, he cried as he [[contemplated]] his future.

senses.en: think about sth. that you might do in the future
examples: Many years ago he had [[contemplated]] writing a book about his childhood.

senses.en: a large building for storing large quantities of goods
examples: Police are investigating a fire at a furniture [[warehouse]].

senses.en: a single seed of corn, wheat, etc.
examples: Mum must have left in a hurry, since there were quite a few [[grains]] of corn left on the floor.

senses.en: the seeds of crops such as corn, wheat or rice that are gathered for use as food, or these crops themselves
examples: The government intends to import only five percent of the country's [[grain]].

senses.en: relating to industry or the people working in it
examples: Reports showed [[industrial]] production rose 1.3 percent in November from the month before.

senses.en: (also revenues) money that a business or organization receives over a period of time, esp. from selling goods or services
examples: These companies are sure to encounter financial trouble if they only rely on advertising [[revenue]] for funding.

senses.en: a person whose job is to kill animals such as rats or mice, because they are annoying or dangerous
examples: Can you believe that nearly one hundred million rats are killed each year by pest [[exterminators]]?

senses.zh: （计划、想法或方法）可行的，可实行的，行得通的
senses.en: a plan, idea, or method that is feasible is possible and is likely to work
examples: It was no longer financially [[feasible]] to keep the community center open.

senses.en: look angrily at sb. for a long time
examples: Noah was furious at what I just said but he didn't shout and just [[glared]] at me silently.

senses.zh: 明确地；尖锐地；直言不讳地
senses.en: in a way that is deliberately meant to show that you are annoyed, bored, or disapprove of sth.
examples: Miss Phillips looked at the clock [[pointedly]] and I realized that it was time for me to leave.

senses.en: a complaint
examples: They've got the usual moans and [[groans]] like everybody else.

senses.zh: （疼痛时的）呻吟；（不愿做某事时的）哼哼声
senses.en: a long deep sound that you make when you are in pain or do not want to do sth.
examples: The rescuers could hear the [[groans]] of someone trapped in the ruins.

senses.en: loud enough for you to hear it
examples: His voice was barely [[audible]] above the noise of the crowd.

senses.zh: 打断某人的讲话；中断某人的行动；打扰
senses.en: stop sb. from continuing what they are saying or doing by suddenly speaking to them, making a noise, etc.
examples: I'm sorry to [[interrupt]] your meeting, but may I speak to Michael for a moment?

senses.en: (fml.)1) sth. that is certain to be successful
examples: His new movie is predicted by many critics to be this season's [[slam]] [[dunk]] hit.

senses.en: (in basketball) the act of jumping up and putting the ball through the net with a lot of force
examples: He marked his first appearance with a [[slam]] [[dunk]] for his first points.

senses.zh: 逐字的（地）；一字不差的（地）
senses.en: (fml.) repeating the actual words that were spoken or written
examples: The president's speeches are regularly reproduced [[verbatim]] in the state-run newspapers.

senses.en: if leaves, papers, clothes, etc. rustle, or if you rustle them, they move about and make a soft, dry sound
examples: A gentle breeze blew through the windows, lightly [[rustling]] the curtains.

senses.zh: 紧张忙乱的；手忙脚乱的
senses.en: done quickly and with a lot of activity, but in a way that is not very well organized
examples: People were [[frantic]], trying to call relatives after the earthquake.

senses.en: done in a hurried way and in a state of excitement or confusion
examples: I've been working [[frantically]] all week to get the term paper finished before the deadline.

senses.en: (pl. indexes) an alphabetical list of names, subjects, etc. at the back of a book, with the numbers of the pages where they can be found
examples: Look under B in the [[index]] to see if biology is covered in the book.

senses.en: (also ~ enough) used to say that sth. seems strange or surprising
examples: [[Oddly]] enough, someone asked me the same question yesterday.

senses.en: in a strange or unusual way
examples: Didn't you think she was behaving very [[oddly]] at Susan's birthday party yesterday?

senses.en: used to say the opposite of a situation you have just described is also true
examples: He refuses to believe anything they say and vice versa.

senses.en: stop doing sth. that is failing, so that one does not waste any more money, time, or effort
examples: [[Cut]] your losses with projects that are not going to work and do things that make you feel comfortable.

senses.en: put your possessions into a bag, etc. before leaving a place
examples: We arrived just as the musicians were [[packing]] up their instruments.

senses.en: have a big smile on your face that clearly shows you are happy or amused
examples: He tiptoed closer, [[smiling]] broadly, waiting for Suzanne to spot him.

senses.en: make sth. less or smaller
examples: Some business owners are [[cutting]] into their profits to help raise money for the foundation.

senses.en: used to say that a particular choice would be more satisfactory
examples: I started to hunt for a cheap restaurant nearby or, better still, a snack shop.

senses.en: give sth. to each person in a group
examples: He was busy [[handing]] out leaflets on the musical to the audience.

senses.en: find an explanation or solution to a problem, by thinking all the possibilities
examples: I spent the entire night [[reasoning]] out the solution to the puzzle.

senses.zh: 认真地考虑（某事可能产生的结果）
senses.en: think carefully about the possible results of sth.
examples: People need time to [[think]] through what the changes in taxation will mean for them.
